page.overview:
What is Invalid Data Value Stone Bricks?

Invalid data value stone bricks refers to item forms of stone bricks with damage values outside of the usual range which stone bricks can usually be obtained in.

Without the use of commands, invalid data value stone bricks items are unobtainable in the last versions in which they existed without inheriting them from a prior version in which they were obtainable.

[https://mcdiscontinued.miraheze.org/wiki/Java_Edition:Block_Transmutation Several methods of block transmutation] can be used to obtain invalid data value stone bricks in block form. These blocks can be mined from Beta 1.8 Pre-release to 14w21b to obtain the item corresponding to these blocks.

For arrow transmutation, the initial block being transmuted must be a regular stone bricks block, i.e. a stone bricks block with metadata value 0. Cracked, mossy or or chiseled stone bricks cannot be transmuted.
